versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides a complete, builder-ready specification flow for designing multi-step online sales funnels.

- Outlines when and when not to use the skill.
- Details essential inputs to collect before funnel design.
- Maps offer types to standard funnel shapes with clear selection criteria.
- Provides structured, page-by-page spec blocks including copy outline, metrics, and instrumentation.
- Includes baseline conversion benchmarks and instrumentation requirements for tracking and optimization.
- Recommends self-hosted, open-source implementation via Autonnel.
